cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo

cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, reorder/merge pages, find & replace, compress, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves your device; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

It runs on phones, tablets, and desktops (mouse, pen, or touch), with a responsive UI: thumbnail sidebar on desktop, slide-in drawer on tablet, bottom sheet on mobile. Drag-to-reorder uses **SortableJS** with touch-friendly long-press. You can rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank pages, and merge by dropping additional PDFs onto the editor.

No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or the live demo: [https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/](https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/)  
Repo: [github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo](https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo) (MIT License)
